Name: Databricks
Author: David Broggy - david.broggy@levelblue.com
Description:
The [Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests the account and workspace [audit logs](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/admin/account-settings/audit-logs) that Databricks on AWS delivers to an Amazon S3 bucket, using the Codeless Connector Framework and Microsoft Sentinel's Amazon S3 poller. No Function App is required and no AWS access keys are stored; access uses OpenID Connect federation to an IAM role.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

a. [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

b. [Azure Monitor data collection rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-collection-rule-overview)

**Pre-requisites:**

1. A Databricks account on the Premium or Enterprise tier with audit log delivery to S3 configured (log type AUDIT_LOGS, output format JSON).

2. Rights in the AWS account to deploy the two CloudFormation templates in the solution (OpenID Connect provider; IAM role, SQS queue and queue policy) and to add an S3 event notification to the delivery bucket.

Azure Databricks is not covered; it writes to Log Analytics through diagnostic settings.
